tlog.msg: Deploying to a new island — new map sheets are in the library [P].
Light: OVERCAST.
CHAPTER 4.2 — TEN METERS (NORMAL). Enemy infantry in the open, reported grid bearing ~5500 mils from your OP. A gift. Do not waste it.

ASSET: 60mm mortar section, callsign HACKSAW FIRES — address THEM, not HELLHOUND; strict net will bounce the wrong callsign. 8-digit grids (10 m precision) required. Tighter dispersion, tighter target.
Par time for full stars: 5:30.
MET: wind from 1000 mils at 2 m/s — read your smoke; it will drift downwind. Rounds are not wind-corrected on this net (the FDC applies met).

Your OP: watchtower at grid 245 553, ground elev 264 m, deck +300 m. Use [B] binos and [L] laser to fix the target ([M] map, [K] mission menu), then send your call for fire — grid, polar, or shift from a known point. Hold [SPACE] to transmit by voice, or type below.

NAVIGATION: your heading readout is MAGNETIC. The grid, the map sheet and the fire net are GRID. Declination is 7° EAST, so GRID = MAG + 124 mils. Send OT DIRECTION in GRID — [R] has the conversion on the mil card, and the sheet carries the declination diagram.

Known points registered: AB1001 "BREWERY" grid 255 547 (grid brg 2135) · AB1002 "LATRINE" grid 260 527 (grid brg 2675). Shift example: "adjust fire, shift known point 1001, right 200, add 400, over" — the KP name works too ("shift BREWERY").

NO-STRIKE: civilian villages KEPA and TAHINGO and FANO — plotted on your map sheet. Collateral damage fails the mission, same as fratricide. Permanent structures and roads are on the sheet too — use them to orient.
>>> THE JOB: Enemy infantry in the open, reported grid bearing ~5500 mils from your OP. A gift. Do not waste it.
NORTHEAST OF THE AMMO DEPOT, WITHIN TWO THOUSAND METRES OF IT
HACKSAW FIRES up. Somewhere on this miserable rock is a grid square that luck itself gave up on. Point me at it, over.
